description: Fuzzy / token search over registry component names (e.g. "dialog", "sheet", "carousel"). Does not install anything. Prefer this before guessing names, then give the user npx ply-ui-cli add <name> (or local stdio add_components).

query.description: Natural-language or substring query (e.g. "dialog modal", "button"). Matches name, description, usage, and keywords.

name: search_components
title: Search Ply components
